notes.title: Mac and Linux builds now available
notes.content:
You can now persue flights of fairy fancy on Mac and Linux!

Additional fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed fireworks hollowing caverns that faeries can't reach because they're only diagonally accessible.
[*]Options window now no longer overrides the window resolution set at start up.
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content:
We've just released a new update for the festive season. Hope you enjoy it!

Game balance tweaks:
[list]
[*] Increased the time before logs decay.
[*] Increased the fraction of chests that contain sparkles.
[*] Addressed a lag on button presses.
[/list]
